_comment: UK English strings. No gambling vocabulary anywhere — use stake/commitment/pledge/forfeit.

AuthButton.step1: Sami World App — app ne kyauta kamar kowanne.
AuthButton.step2: Buɗe World App ka taɓa mai binciken QR a babban shafi, ka nuna shi ga wannan lamba.
AuthButton.step3: DoomTax yana buɗewa a cikin World App. Taɓa Haɗa — yana sanya hannu a saƙo ɗaya don tabbatar kai ne. Babu wani abu da ake cajin, babu wani abu da ke motsi. DoomTax yana saita asusun zamaninka ta atomatik — babu wani abu da za a haɗa.
AuthButton.step4: Yana aiki a hanyar gwaji ta Hedera — alkawurra ba su da kuɗin gaske yau.

StakeForm.description: Rubuta shi kamar alkawarin da kake yi wa kanka. Kocin AI ɗinka yana karanta waɗannan kalmomi daidai lokacin da yake yanke hukunci akan shaida — ka kasance takamaiman don hukuncin ya bayyana.
StakeForm.placeholderIntention: Kammala wakili na tsarawa kuma ka sami biyan kuɗi ɗaya yana aiki daga farko zuwa ƙarshe
StakeForm.qualityHint: Niyyoyi masu kyau ana iya tabbatar da su: sanya sunan aiki da lokacin da ake ɗaukarsa a matsayin an gama.
StakeForm.sessionInfo: Lamunin {stake} ℏ ɗinka yana a hanyar gwaji ta Hedera na {duration}. Cika alkawarin kuma zai dawo cikakke. Rashin cika zai tafi ga manufar tare, ba zuwa gare mu ba. Kana iya kashe zaman a kowane lokaci kafin tsarawa.

ArtifactForm.heading: Nuna aikin ka
ArtifactForm.youCommitted: Ka yi alkawari game da wannan:
ArtifactForm.placeholderArtifact: Liƙa abin da ka samar, ko kwatanta abin da ka gama da inda yake.
ArtifactForm.coachReads: Abin da kocin ka ke karba
ArtifactForm.coachReceivesIntention: Niyyarka da rubutun da ke sama
ArtifactForm.coachNeverReceivesAttachment: Haɗin ka — baya taba barin wannan waya (har yanzu)
ArtifactForm.coachPrivacy: Ba tabar allo ba, tarihin bincike ba, maɓallan keyboard ba, ko kowane abu daga sauran apps ba.
ArtifactForm.coachReadingBody: Yana aiki a sirrance a 0G, sannan yana tsarawa a Hedera. Wannan yana ɗaukar ɗan lokaci.
ArtifactForm.attachButton: Haɗa hoton aikin ka — zaɓi ne
ArtifactForm.attachCaption: Yana zaune a na'ura ka. Ana ƙididdige sawun yatsa (hash) a gida don sigar gaba ta iya tabbatar da shi a sarkar. Ana zuwa da karantawar OCR a 0G — yau koci yana yanke hukunci akan rubutun ka kawai.

Verdict.publicReceiptDetail: Yana ɗauke da hash na alkawari da hukunci kawai. Ba niyyarka ko abin ka ba.

ConfirmSheet.title: Kashe wannan zaman?
ConfirmSheet.body: Lamunin <amount>{stake} ℏ</amount> ɗinka yana dawo gare ka cikakke kuma babu wani abu da ake rasa. Zaman yana ƙarewa yanzu kuma ba a aika wa kocin ka ba. Yi amfani da wannan lokacin da shiri ya canza gaskiya, ba a matsayin al'ada ba.
ConfirmSheet.confirm: Kashe kuma ka mayar mani da lamunina

CirclePanel.impactDetail: {count} hasarori sun ba da kuɗi ga wannan manufa. Babu matsayin, babu adadin mutum ɗaya, kuma ba a taɓa ambaton wanda ya kasa ba.
CirclePanel.pendingForfeit: Idan wannan zaman ya tsaya, <amount>{stake} HBAR</amount> zai haɗu da jimlar da'irar ka bayan tagar ɗaukaka. Aikin mai kyau yana ƙidaya, amma sunanka ba ya tafiya tare da shi.
CirclePanel.private: Da'irar ka tana zama ta sirri. Muna nuna abin da kuka ɗaukar tare, ba jerin membobi ba — kuma ba taɓa wanda ya kasa ba.

About.heroTitle: Hanya mai laushi don canza niyya zuwa aiki
About.heroBody: DoomTax kayan aiki ne na mai da hankali bisa binciken na'urar alkawari daga tattalin arzikin hali. Ka sanya sunan aiki ɗaya, ka sa ƙaramin lamuni a bayan sa, kuma ka sami hukunci na gaskiya a ƙarshe.
About.gettingInBody: DoomTax yana aiki a matsayin ƙaramin app a cikin World App. Yi amfani da lambar QR a ƙasa don buɗe ta a wayarka.
About.readyBody: Fara da ƙaramin lamuni. Binciken yana bayyana cewa girman ya fi muhimmanci ƙasa da yin alkawarin na gaske — zaɓi wani abu da gaskiya kake nufin gama a zaman na gaba.
